title: Container Bookings: request window for goodwill on a customer roll fee
content:
## Rule
A goodwill waiver of a Container Bookings customer roll fee is granted only when the request falls no later than the tier's goodwill request window, in calendar days, after the booking date of the fee entry concerned, counted on calendar dates.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical window)
*Hypothetical window of 20 calendar days, for illustration only:*
| Fee entry booked on | Request made on | Calendar days after | Window condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January | 30 January | 20 | met |
| 10 January | 31 January | 21 | not met |
| 10 January | 10 January | 0 | met |

## Points of judgement
**Does the time of day of the request matter?** No. The count runs on calendar dates.
